messages:
Sophie (Partner Ops): Hey all — NimbusCloud reported a marketplace listing issue that caused our dedicated customers to see a 502 when selecting the region. They want a clear escalation flow. Can we confirm how we should handle partner SEV1s vs SEV2s and the shared channel handoff?

Ravi (EngOps): I can take the engineering side. Quick answers: SEV1 (production outage impacting >X customers) => immediate war room + pager + partner bridge. SEV2 (degraded but not down) => shared slack channel + async tracking.

Jordan (Partner Success): +1. For partners we should always have a named partner contact + an internal SRE and a product owner in the loop. For Nimbus specifically, their oncall is @Nimbus-oncall.

Sophie (Partner Ops): OK — proposed procedure: 1) Partner reports incident -> post in #partners-nimbus (shared channel) 2) If partner marks SEV1, the poster runs `/call-warroom` and tags `@oncall` 3) Eng oncall joins bridge + partner bridge created by ops. Does that align?

Emil (Oncall): That aligns but add escalation timeboxes: 5m ack, 15m triage, 30m mitigation plan. Also include an explicit fallback: if bridge creation fails, create a Zoom link and paste in #partners-nimbus + DM partner PM.

Oncall Bot: Pager: Emil (Oncall) has been paged for incident 2026-04-12-001. Join war room: https://warroom.redwood/2026-04-12-001

Ana (Marketplace): From marketplace side — we need an extra step for listing-related incidents: notify marketplace compliance and billing teams (they have read-only access). For SEV1s that affect customers purchasing flow, mark the listing as temporarily disabled and notify cloud marketplace partner ops.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Practical note: when hardware or SI partners are involved, include an inventory snippet in the initial post: `Model: rdx-32, Firmware: 1.4.2, Batch: eu-3`. That saves time diagnosing variant-specific bugs.

Nikhil (Hardware Partner): for hardware-related escalations we prefer a dedicated private channel (e.g., #partners-nikhil-hw) and a secure artifact upload location for logs (S3 presigned). Can Redwood ops auto-create that when SEV1 is declared?

Ravi (EngOps): Yes, we can provision a private ephemeral channel via the ops bot. It will be permissioned for partner users + the incident participants. We should document TTL (default 7 days) and archive rules.

Sophie (Partner Ops): Good. I'll draft an SOP. Key items to include: - how to label severity (what counts as SEV1/2/3) - whom to @ for each severity - steps to create partner bridge + fallback - where to upload logs and sample commands - postmortem ownership rules.

Jordan (Partner Success): Add contract constraints: if partner support window is limited (e.g., business hours only), make that explicit in the shared channel topic and in the incident header. Also include who can authorize customer credits or SLA abatements.

Kai (Legal): For cross-org war rooms, make sure the NDA/IA terms are honored. If sensitive PII or customer data is uploaded, prefer the secure upload and alert compliance.

Sophie (Partner Ops): Draft SOP link: https://docs.internal/redwood/partner-escalation/v1 (working draft). Can folks review quickly? I want to test this on a tabletop with Nimbus tomorrow at 10am PT.

Emil (Oncall): I'll be there. I want to test the ops-bot channel creation and the auto-bridge.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short kit for partners: a one-pager with the commands and where to grab logs, plus a sample `incident.json` payload we expect.

Partner: NimbusCloud: thanks — we appreciate the clarity. We'll confirm our oncall rotation and share contact details before the tabletop.

Lena (Customer): FWIW — our team was affected yesterday. Happy to join the tabletop to represent end-user impact.

Ravi (EngOps): Action items captured: - Sophie: finalize SOP + link (due EOD) - Ana: confirm marketplace disable flow and who to ping (due EOD) - Sam: prepare partner kit (due tomorrow) - Emil: test ops-bot for channel/bridge creation (due tomorrow 09:30 PT) - Nimbus: share oncall contact (due tonight)

Sophie (Partner Ops): Thanks all. If anyone sees gaps (e.g., phone bridge numbers, legal signoff) add them here. Otherwise I'll spin up the tabletop invite. :thumbsup:
